Synopsis:
Dialog when interactin with the shrine dedicated to Selune in Stormshore Tabernacle. All players will be able to read some lore about the god. Additionally, if the player is a cleric of Selune they'll be able to give offerings and pray/communicate with the god to get a blessing.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_StormshoreTabernacle_SeluneShrine.json: You are standing before an altar to Selûne in the Stormshore Tabernacle; an inscription on the altar can be read by anyone and gives a short prayer about Selûne’s changing light and guidance. All characters will see the basic lore line identifying Selûne as the moon-and-stars goddess who helps wanderers. Characters with relevant scholarship in Religion (or who pass the associated check) will gain a bit more contextual knowledge; without that skill they get only the limited inscription text. If the player is a cleric/follower of Selûne, the goddess may acknowledge them (the “Moonmaiden welcomes you”), and they can offer gifts, pray, and receive a blessing.

context: You are at the Selûne altar in the Stormshore Tabernacle; anyone can read the carved inscription that offers a short prayer about Selûne’s changing light and guidance for wanderers. Characters who pass a Religion check (or have relevant scholarship) see a bit more contextual lore; those who fail only get the basic inscription text. If the player is a cleric or devoted follower of Selûne, the Moonmaiden may acknowledge them (e.g., “Selûne welcomes you”) and the player is offered options to give offerings, pray, and receive a blessing. The examples show the inscription, the Religion-check branching, and the special acknowledgment reserved for Selûne’s clergy.
